name: ENVE 3230
title: Air Pollution Control
description: Gaseous pollutants and their properties; basic analytical techniques for air pollutants; particulate pollutants and their properties; equipment design for removal of gaseous and particulate materials; economic and environmental impact of air pollutants; federal and state regulations.
requirement_description: ENVE 2310E or CHEG 2103; enrollment in the School of Engineering. Recommended preparation: CHEG 2111 or ME 2233.
